BiblicalUsage: Sekel is understanding, intelligence with success in it, and Scripture gives it to the people God is building. David prayed that the LORD would give Solomon wisdom and understanding, and charge concerning Israel, that he may keep the law. Abigail was a woman of good understanding, and Huram blessed God for giving David a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, to build the house of the LORD. And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe understanding is the gift that makes obedience possible: David asked it for his son, Abigail carried it into a violent house, and the Levites taught it to the people. It is not cleverness — it is knowing God's law and keeping it. And I hold that the understanding that builds God's house is the same understanding that teaches His people, and it all comes from the Lord.
